name: Northline Commons
summary: Northline Commons is an outdoor shopping mall in North Houston featuring a diverse mix of retail shops, service providers, and dining establishments. This community-focused center offers convenient access to everyday shopping needs in an open-air setting with extended operating hours.
demographics: Northline Commons serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income demographic in North Houston, with a significant Hispanic population reflecting the surrounding neighborhoods. The trade area attracts families and value-conscious shoppers seeking convenient access to everyday retail, dining, and services. Primary visitors include households with children, young professionals, and multi-generational families who prioritize accessibility and practical shopping options over luxury experiences.
description: Northline Commons is a vibrant outdoor shopping destination located at 4400 North Freeway in Houston, Texas, serving the diverse North Houston community. This open-air shopping center offers visitors a convenient and accessible retail experience with a wide range of shops, service providers, and dining options all in one location. Managed by the North American Development Group with General Manager Anas Maguz at the helm, Northline Commons has established itself as a community hub where locals can shop, dine, and enjoy quality time with family and friends. The center's outdoor layout provides a pleasant shopping atmosphere with ample parking and easy navigation between stores. With operating hours from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Northline Commons accommodates early morning shoppers and evening diners alike, making it a versatile destination for the neighborhood's daily needs and weekend outings.
